mapper.sql: id, org_code, org_name, parent_id, org_path, status, remark, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
select
from sys_org where 1 = 1
and status = #{status}
order by org_path asc, id asc

select
from sys_org where id = #{orgId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_org ( org_code, org_name, parent_id, org_path, status, remark, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{orgCode}, #{orgName}, #{parentId}, #{orgPath}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update sys_org set org_name = #{orgName}, parent_id = #{parentId}, org_path = #{orgPath}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_org ( user_id, org_id, is_primary, joined_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{orgId}, #{isPrimary}, now() )
mapper.select: select org_id from sys_user_org where user_id = #{userId} and is_primary = 1 order by joined_at desc, id desc limit 1
